model: Booster systems (Hydro MPC, Hydro Multi-E, Multi-B) via CIM 200 / CIM 500
applies_to: Grundfos booster systems: Hydro MPC / Control MPC (CU 352), GENIECON MPC, Hydro Multi-B (CU 323), DDD (CU 354), Hydro Multi-E, TPED and MAGNA3-D twin pumps, with CIM/CIU 200, CIM/CIU 500 or SoftCIM.
summary: Grundfos multi-pump booster sets and twin-head pumps share one Modbus functional profile, reached through a CIM 200 (RTU) or CIM 500 (Modbus TCP) module or the SoftCIM port on GENIECON and newer MGE pumps. The map covers system start/stop, control mode and setpoint, per-pump force start/stop, system status and alarm codes, system measurements and a status/data block for each of up to six pumps. Which registers are live depends on the booster type and installed sensors.

addressing.note: Registers are printed as 5-digit register numbers; the manual states register X is addressed as X-1 in the telegram (setpoint 00104 is sent as 00103).

source.title: Modbus for Grundfos boosters - SoftCIM Modbus RTU, SoftCIM Modbus TCP, CIM/CIU 200 Modbus RTU, CIM/CIU 500 Modbus TCP - Functional profile and user manual
source.pages: pp. 5 (products), 18-38 (register blocks incl. pump 1-6 and pump energy), 44-46 (alarm codes), 52-55 (telegram examples)

notes: All blocks can be read with function code 03 or 04; listed here as holding registers. Control and configuration registers are written with 06 or 16.
32-bit values are HI/LO register pairs with HI at the lower address; the manual combines them as HI x 65536 + LO (ABCD).
Temperatures are in 0.01 K (kelvin) except HeatDiffTemp (00369), which is published in 0.01 °C.
A raw value of 0xFFFF means 'not available'. Many registers apply only to particular booster types or need a sensor; see the support columns in the manual.

Pump blocks repeat every 10 registers: pump 1 at 00401, pump 2 at 00411 ... pump 6 at 00451. Pump power is in 10 W steps. Pilot and backup pump blocks (00461, 00471) and Pump-x energy for pilot/backup were left out.

Left out: tank-filling limits (00111-00114, 00215-00219), DDD remote-sensor setpoints and fieldbus sensor block (00119-00128, 00146-00156), manual pump speeds (00136-00143), PI tuning registers 00144/00145 and 00231/00232 (offset/scaling not clear enough), FeedbackSensorMin/Max (00221/00222, no scaling given), analog input values/units (00224-00230, 00376-00382, scaling depends on an enum), flow measurements 1-3 and remote/differential pressures not listed above, and the DDD logged sensor data. Alarm simulation registers were also omitted.
AlarmCode 00205 lists booster-system codes; when the alarm comes from an individual pump the pump's own Grundfos code is reported (see the E-pump code list).

integration.summary: Address the CIM (rotary switches on the CIM 200, IP on the CIM 500), enable bus control in the controller if it is an MPC/GENIECON/DDD, then write 00101 = 3 to take remote control and start, and 00104 for the setpoint in 0.01 %. Poll 00201 for on/alarm/warning, 00205 for the alarm code, 00301/00302 for pressure and flow and 00209/00210 for per-pump running and alarm bits.
integration.enable: Set 00101 bit 0 (RemoteAccessReq) = 1 and bit 1 (OnOffReq) to start/stop. For Hydro MPC, GENIECON and DDD you must also set the controller's control source to 'From bus' (Settings > Secondary functions > Control source). With a CIM in more than one pump of a Multi-E/TPED, control registers must be written to every pump head.
integration.watchdog: Register 00012 sets a comm-loss timeout of 5-3600 s (0 = disabled, default). On timeout the booster returns to Local mode.
quirks: Register numbers are 1-based: 00104 is wire address 103.
Temperatures are in 0.01 K; HeatDiffTemp is in 0.01 °C.
Pump block power is scaled 10 W per count, unlike the system power register (1 W, 32-bit).
ResetAlarm acts on a rising edge; if AutoAckControlBits (00005) = 0, clear the bit before the next reset.
setup: CIM 200: address on hex rotary switches SW6/SW7; baud on SW4/SW5 (default 19200); parity on SW3 (default even, 1 stop bit); termination via SW1/SW2.
CIM 500: set the protocol rotary switch to Modbus TCP and configure the Modbus TCP IP address in the module web server.
Hydro MPC / GENIECON / DDD: select 'From bus' as control source in the controller HMI before expecting Modbus commands to act.
gotchas: Many measurements return 0xFFFF on a given booster type because the sensor or function is not present.
Hydro Multi-E model G can only run in auto-control and OpenLoopMax; several pump-block values are unavailable on model G.

address_note: address = 0-based Modbus wire (PDU) address; documented = as printed in the source.
note: Re-typed from the manufacturer's public documentation (see source) and verified against it. Registers vary by firmware and options; verify against the live device before writing.
